about: Expressions the kernel (kernel/internal/cel, cel_parity_test.go) and the web app's engine.js (test/engine.test.js) must evaluate to the same value: the dialect a paired device needs to compute pos_sale and its promo lines offline (contracts 0058 §10, 0069 §2). Numbers compare as numbers. Avoid int / int division: the kernel divides integers, engine.js does not.
